messages.content: Mary Smith wants to know what she has rented. What films has she rented, and does she currently have any rentals outstanding?

function.name: execute_sql
function.arguments: {"query":"SELECT f.title, r.rental_date, r.return_date FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.customer_id = 1"}
